text:
Alice Chen: Quick proposal for our weekly triage (recurring Wed): shorten to 30m, split into two lanes (hotfix / backlog), and pair owners for handoffs. Keep deep dives async. Thoughts?

Marco Ruiz: Sounds good. What time are we thinking? 09:30 PT might work for US+EU overlap.

Priya Patel: Agree on lanes. +1 for pairing owners — reduces chase. Suggest agenda: 5m sync, 10m hotfix lane, 10m backlog quick triage, 5m action items.

Dave L.: Happy to pair w/ Priya this week. Also can take rotating owner roster if helpful.

Priya Patel: If we do 30m, can we require pre-reads in thread with `/triage` tag? That keeps meeting focused.

Alice Chen: Yes — let's require an async pre-thread w/ CI/rep steps + one-line verdict. I'll draft calendar invite if time locked.

oncall-bot: Reminder: last week's triage overran by 12m. Please keep timeboxed.

Marco Ruiz: :thumbsup: 09:30 PT works for me. Should we alternate Tues/Wed some weeks?

Alice Chen: Prefer keep weekly Wed for predictability. Can set owner pairs to 2-week rotate. Proposed new agenda block (please react with :thumbsup: to approve time & :eyes: if you want changes):

```
Agenda (30m):
00:00-00:05 — quick status & blockers
00:05-00:15 — Hotfix lane (owner reports + action)
00:15-00:25 — Backlog triage (PRs > 2w, regressions)
00:25-00:30 — Owners & next-step assignments
```

Require async pre-reads posted 24h prior with `/triage` tag.

Marco Ruiz: I'll add recurring invite at 09:30 PT Wed. If EU folks object we can adjust.

Priya Patel: One ask: can we include a 'customer impact' flag in pre-reads (high/med/low)? Helps prioritize.

Dave L.: Also propose a tiny workshop once/month: 15m to surface systemic triage friction. Keep optional.

Alice Chen: Love it. I'll set the invite, add owner pairing rota, and post a short template for pre-reads. Assigning first pair: Priya + Dave for next Wed.

Priya Patel: Thanks — I'll post a `/triage` thread with backlog highlights by EOD Tue.

Marco Ruiz: :calendar: added. :thumbsup: 

Dave L.: :raised_hands: I'll prep the rota doc.

Alice Chen: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD today I'll lock this change. :slightly_smiling_face:
